steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required for event creation.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply a questionnaire template to the RFP.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete mandatory questionnaire configuration for the technical stage.
Assign the evaluator required for publishing an RFP.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required and leave Delivery within 7 days as None, then click Done and stop on the create screen showing the configured terms

steps.note: Configure the required and optional clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA vendor to the event.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFP.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's technical questionnaire as the vendor.
Confirm the vendor can see the terms block.
Accept only the optional clause.

args.goal: On the vendor's technical response screen, answer the questionnaire and attempt to submit while "Payment within 45 days" remains unchecked; verify the submission is blocked, the required clause is highlighted or identified as required, and no response is submitted

steps.note: Exercise the negative submission path and verify required-clause enforcement.
Accept the required clause after the blocked attempt.

args.goal: On the vendor's technical response screen, submit the already answered questionnaire after both terms are accepted and stop when the vendor screen shows the response was submitted

steps.note: Verify that accepting the required clause allows submission.
Assert the vendor response was successfully submitted.
